title: Greaves wins Women's Matchplay in last-leg decider
dek: Beau Greaves claimed her third Women's World Matchplay title in four years by defeating Fallon Sherrock in a final that went to the last leg, according to BBC Sport.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Greaves won the Women's World Matchplay for the third time in four years, beating Sherrock in a last-leg decider.
bottom_line: Greaves' third title in four years establishes her as the face of women's darts competition. Watch for her appearance in major mixed and team events, and whether other competitors can bridge the gap to her win rate in high-stakes matchplay formats.
body: Beau Greaves claimed the Women's World Matchplay title by defeating Fallon Sherrock in a final decided by the last leg, according to BBC Sport. The victory marks Greaves' third Women's World Matchplay crown in four years, cementing her position as the sport's dominant women's player.

The match hinged on the final leg, with both competitors advancing through the tournament to reach the decider. Sherrock, a prominent figure in women's darts, could not overcome Greaves in the closing moment of the contest.
